title: N-Length Consecutive Numbers
scenario: Find all numbers that appear at least 5 times consecutively. Return 'ConsecutiveNums'.
hint: Use LEAD/LAG or ROW_NUMBER to compare current with previous 4 rows.
correctQuery: SELECT DISTINCT l1.num AS "ConsecutiveNums" FROM logs l1 JOIN logs l2 ON l1.id = l2.id - 1 JOIN logs l3 ON l1.id = l3.id - 2 JOIN logs l4 ON l1.id = l4.id - 3 JOIN logs l5 ON l1.id = l5.id - 4 WHERE l1.num = l2.num AND l2.num = l3.num AND l3.num = l4.num AND l4.num = l5.num;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, num VARCHAR); INSERT INTO logs VALUES (1, '1'), (2, '1'), (3, '1'), (4, '1'), (5, '1');
